CustomField.description: When ticked for the running user, inserting a Transaction Record earns no loyalty points. Set it on the migration user before importing historical bills from CASA - those bills have already earned their points, and the balances come across separately - then clear it once the load is done. Leave it off at the org default so the POS never stops earning by accident.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick only for a data-migration user, and only while the load is running.
CustomField.label: Disable Earning
